security_audit.summary: AI review found no malicious intent, prompt injection, network access, or secret exfiltration in the cited files. Most static hits are Markdown formatting, command examples, or generic documentation headings. The remaining confirmed concern is unrestricted JSON report output writes in the three helper scripts.

remediation.suggestion: Normalize --output paths, reject parent traversal, refuse existing files unless --force is set, and default to stdout.

remediation.issue: Operational command examples need clearer guardrails
remediation.suggestion: Label npm, Docker, and Kubernetes commands as user-approved examples, and avoid implying automatic execution by agents.

remediation.issue: Environment setup command can overwrite local configuration
remediation.suggestion: Use a non-overwriting copy pattern or document a check before creating .env from .env.example.

static_findings.snippet: Check the comprehensive troubleshooting section in `references/development_workflows.md`.

content.value_statement: Fullstack teams need consistent project structure, architecture guidance, and quality checks. This skill provides reference guides and Python CLI helpers for setup and review.
actual_capabilities: Documents stack choices for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, and cloud platforms.
Provides three Python CLI helpers for validating an existing target path and producing a status report.
Prints the target path, run status, and findings count for each helper script.
Can emit JSON results to stdout or to a user-selected output file.
Includes reference guides for architecture patterns, development workflows, and technology stack planning.
limitations: The current scripts are placeholders and do not create application files.
The analyzer returns an empty findings list until deeper checks are implemented.
Shell examples assume the required local tools are already installed.
Users must review deployment and environment commands before running them.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Web Application
use_cases.description: Use the stack and architecture guides to outline frontend, backend, database, and deployment choices.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workflows
use_cases.description: Use the workflow reference to align setup, quality checks, documentation, and troubleshooting practices.

use_cases.title: Run Lightweight Project Reports
use_cases.description: Run the Python helpers against an existing path to produce a basic status report for review.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Stack Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to summarize the recommended fullstack technologies for my web application. Keep the plan practical.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Project Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the appropriate helper on my project path and explain the reported status in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Architecture Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the architecture and workflow references to plan a Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL application.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Delivery Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a delivery workflow that combines setup, code quality review, testing, deployment checks, and manual approval points.

output_examples.input: Analyze the current project for readiness.
output_examples.output: A concise report showing the target path, success status, and the current number of findings.

output_examples.input: Help choose a stack for a React and Node.js product.
output: A recommended frontend, backend, database, and deployment stack.
A short explanation of trade-offs and implementation priorities.
A checklist for setup, testing, and documentation.

output_examples.input: Prepare workflow guidance for a fullstack team.
output_examples.output: A practical workflow covering setup, quality checks, architecture references, troubleshooting, and release preparation.

best_practices: Confirm the target path before running helper scripts or writing report files.
Use the reference guides to document architecture decisions before implementation.
Treat generated reports as starting points and perform manual review before changes.
anti_patterns: Running shell examples without understanding their local or deployment impact.
Expecting the placeholder scripts to generate a production application.
Copying environment files without checking existing local configuration first.

faq.question: Does this skill generate a complete application?
faq.answer: No. The current scripts validate paths and produce basic reports, but they do not create full application files.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Does the skill access the network?
faq.answer: No network access was found in the reviewed files.

faq.question: Can the scripts write files?
faq.answer: Yes. They can write JSON output to a user-selected path when --output is used.

faq.question: What technologies are covered?
faq.answer: The documentation references React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms.

faq.question: Should deployment examples run automatically?
faq.answer: No. Docker and Kubernetes examples should require explicit user approval before execution.
